title: tier-2 shipped code: texture payload GUID formula against PayloadGuid (0x142e37520)
notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is crates/ow-tank/src/guid.rs, built by cargo and called by crates/ow-tank/src/bin/verify_probe.rs through the payload_guid entry.
Oracle is PayloadGuid at exe 0x142e37520 (v2b 0x7ff7c7b57520). It returns u64 in RAX; arguments are u64 parent (RCX) and uint index (EDX).

The client keeps parent bits 0..31 and 36..39 (mask 0xF0FFFFFFFF), puts the index in bits 32..35, derives a 2-bit base from the parent type (0 for 0x004, 1 for 0x0F1, 3 otherwise) and writes the payload type 0x04D in bits 48..59. The fixture pins all three type branches, the kept and cleared bit groups, and the index nibble.
The six golden texture assets' separate payload assets resolve at the formula's output (0x03200001000009C1 and 0x03200002000009C1 for 0x0C000000000009C1), so the formula is also install-confirmed.
